objects.name: Detection technique coverage: cisco-duo-policy-allow-old-flash
objects.description: The following analytic identifies instances where a Duo administrator creates or updates a policy to allow the use of outdated Flash components, specifically by detecting policy changes with the flash_remediation=no remediation attribute. It leverages Duo activity logs ingested via the Cisco Security Cloud App, searching for policy_update or policy_create actions and parsing the policy description for indicators of weakened security controls.
